TEXT: Pulled along by Saori, we ended up in...
Maid café "Pretty Garden".
The usual place that we often hang out at...
As well as the place that Saori and I first met.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: We're meeting your benefactor here?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Yes. I made a reservation.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hmm.
Someone that resembles Saori Bajeena, huh...
I wonder what kind of person would show up.

SPEAKER: SPK_MAID
TEXT: Welcome~♪

SPEAKER: SPK_MAID
TEXT: Is it just the two of you for today?
This person is Hoshino Kirara.
A maid who works at this cafe.
Don't tell me, she is Saori's benefactor...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: I have a reservation under Saori Bajeena.
Doesn't look like that's the case.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRARA
TEXT: Certainly, Lieutenant Bajeena♪

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRARA
TEXT:
Please follow me to your seats. Your companion is 
waiting for you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hey Saori, does she mean...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Fufufu... Looks like we've kept someone waiting.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRARA
TEXT: Now then, this way please.

Following Kirara's lead, when we arrived at our 
seats...
There was a little girl waiting for us.

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN_2
TEXT: Yaho~!
This cute little girl... is Saori's benefactor?

At first glance, all I can see is an elementary school 
girl...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: I am repentant for the wait. It has been a while.

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN_2
TEXT:
It sure has! We last met around... two Summer 
Comikets ago?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Yes. Have you been well?

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN_2
TEXT: Naturally~♪ I've been super!

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN_2
TEXT: That's my only redeeming trait, after all.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Again with your jokes.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
There aren't many who possess the amount of 
great traits you have.

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN_2
TEXT: Geez, you think too much of me.

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN_2
TEXT:
Heh... I am, after all, the smallest here at Pretty 
Garden.

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN_2
TEXT: Just kidding♪
This frivolous personality...
and that appearance of an elementary school girl...
I remember seeing her before.
But... two Summer Comikets ago...
Was that what she said?
I feel that it was somewhere else instead...
Ah crap. I had it on the tip of my tongue.
Well, at least she doesn't resemble "Saori Bajeena".
Not in her speech, personality, or outfit.

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN_2
TEXT: That aside~, Saori-shi~

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN_2
TEXT: Is that the guy you wanted to introduce me to?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
Yes indeed. The whole purpose of today was to get 
you two to meet.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: *cough* Now then.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: This is Kousaka Kyousuke-shi.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Fufun~, my boyfriend.

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN_2
TEXT: Eh?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: H-Hey there.

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN_2
TEXT: [font_size=26]E[/font_size][font_size=24]h[/font_size]--!　[font_size=33]Really!?[/font_size] Really [font_size=28]really!?[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN_2
TEXT: Saori-chan's boyfriend!

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN_2
TEXT: [font_size=26]No way, no way! Wow-!![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN_2
TEXT: Whaaaaaaaaa~~
This is one high-spirited kid.

Isn't Saori's benefactor, around the level of a high 
schooler...

Elementary... I was expecting at least a middle 
schooler.

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN_2
TEXT: Not bad, not bad. He's definitely my type.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: I won't give him to you, y'know?

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN_2
TEXT: Kay~.

She's not exactly my type, but she's still pretty 
gorgeous.

When a cute girl calls me her "type", I can't help 
but get excited.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Now then Kyousuke-shi. I'll introduce her to you.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
This is Kurusu Kanata-san. She is an old 
acquaintance as well as my precious benefactor.
Saori used "-san." instead of her usual "-shi" suffix.
Since it's her benefactor, she's special.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT: Good to meet-cha, Kyousuke-kun♪

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Same here, nice to meet you.
Kurusu Kanata-chan, huh.
Hmm, somehow that name sounds familiar.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Um, is it fine if I call you Kurusu-chan?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT: It's okay to be more casual~

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Then... Kanata-chan?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT: That's fine, sure... but...

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT: Could you call me, Kanakana-chan?
...What's with this deja vu.
I know I've heard this line from someone before.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Kyousuke-shi, Kyousuke-shi.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Huh? What's up?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: She's our senior, older even.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Huh? Who is?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Kanata-san is older than you, you know?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...W-What did you say?

In a panic, I look again at Kanata-chan, I mean 
Kanata-san.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT: Hihi, I got exposed.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...For real? You're older?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT: Yo. I'm a working adult, despite my appearance.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...I can't picture that at all.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT: Uhihihi-, I look way younger than I actually am.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT: I wonder if I could pass for a high schooler?
You mean an elementary schooler.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Um, Kanata-san.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT: What is it, Kyousuke-kun?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
You're Saori's benefactor, the person who gave her 
those glasses, is what I've heard but...

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT:
Benefactor...? Ahaha, I haven't done anything of that 
sort though.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT: I just hang out with her, like I normally do.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
Which to me, was worth more than I can payback 
in a lifetime.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT: Just as always, you exaggerate too much.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Not at all.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
Since the beginning when I formed the "Otaku Girls 
Unite" circle, till now.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
Kanata-san, you were the one who gave me the 
push to start it all.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT: ...S-So I did do something, huh.

It wasn't out of modesty, but Kanata-san really 
became flustered.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
Yeah, it gave me a great amount of strong and 
stern encouragement.
But to Saori, it was definitely a life-changing event.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT:
Heh~, really~, ahahaha♪ Oh my~, I must have 
been amazing back then!

"Crap! I don't remember at all!" is written all over 
her face.
She certainly seems like that kind of person.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT: Now then.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT:
We have plenty to talk about, and Kyousuke-kun is 
here too.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT:
And besides, I pretty much forgotten all about 
what happened.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Yeah.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Let's bring the past back up then.
